title: Grand Vault v0.0.12 — lean SSoT (shared types only)
description: Lean SSoT of SHARED/universal types. v0.0.12 (patch over v0.0.11): the A2Envelope DOCUMENT signature slot is now $signatures (array of BlockSignature) for multi-party signing (甲乙…) — every party signs the same canonical body; single-signer = length 1. BlockSignature gains an optional informative `signer` (per-signer email / party / identityAssurance / signedAt). The per-block single-author $signature on the other 9 defs is UNCHANGED. v0.0.11 added OperationLog (§3). GV-lean: compliance-DOMAIN §10 entity defs (ComplianceLog, AccessControlEvent, DataSubjectRequest, IncidentReport, PIIDetection, GovernanceAttestation, DataLineage) live in the compliance PROFILE, not here; only the shared ConsentReceipt + ComplianceFrameworkEnum remain (reused by contract / the core AuditSession). §3 AI-audit (AIAction/Instruction/AuditSession) retains its EU-AI-Act fields. All other schemas $ref defs here.
x-a2-deprecation-policy: Defs marked x-a2-deprecated remain available for 2 minor versions before removal.

NodeIdType.description: Document-unique node identifier. Canonical form: '<prefix>-<uuidv7>'. NCName-compatible, xs:ID semantics.

GroundingPolicyEnum.description: AI inference control. 'strict'=cite only facts; 'embargo'=MUST NOT be used by AI.

ApprovedBy.$comment: G15: signatureRef must resolve to a Signature in the document.

_____LEAF_TYPES_____.description: ─── §5 Leaf / Data Types — updated with $signature and $hashChain ────────

Value.description: G17 Branch B L6 concrete. Core leaf element. v0.0.2: adds optional $signature (B-B) and $hashChain for individual high-value data points.

$signature.description: G19. Optional per-Value ML-DSA/JWS signature. Recommended profile: B-B. Use for high-value scalar data points (financial figures, medical measurements, legal identifiers). Payload = RFC8785(Value object excluding [$signature, $hashChain]).

$hashChain.description: G20. Optional per-Value hash chain anchor. Use for audit-critical Values (e.g. measurement readings in a sequence). seqNo tracks Value ordering within the document chain.

groundingNote.description: a2: AI推論補足・制約・文脈。

Ref.description: G17 Branch C L5 concrete. Typed cross-reference edge. v0.0.2: adds optional $signature (B-B) for signed relationship assertions.

$signature.description: G19. Optional per-Ref ML-DSA/JWS signature. Recommended profile: B-B. Signs the relationship assertion (rel, from, to). Useful for signed knowledge graph edges.

allOf.$comment: G16 x-externalValidate: subClass validates rel token.

_____COMPOSITE_TYPES_____.description: ─── §6 Composite / Container Types — updated with $signature and $hashChain ─

ValueBlock.description: G17 Branch A-ext L4 concrete. Named value group. v0.0.2: adds $signature (B-T recommended) and $hashChain for group-level integrity.

$signature.description: G19. Optional per-ValueBlock ML-DSA/JWS signature. Recommended profile: B-T (with timestamp). Payload covers: name, id, type, all children — enabling detection of child insertions/deletions. Signing all children hash means child order matters.

$hashChain.description: G20. Optional per-ValueBlock hash chain anchor. Links this named value group into the document chain for reordering/deletion detection.

SemanticBlock.description: G17 Branch A-ext L5 concrete. Mixed prose/structured block. v0.0.2: adds $signature (B-T recommended) for signed narrative sections.

$signature.description: G19. Optional per-SemanticBlock ML-DSA/JWS signature. Recommended profile: B-T. Signs the prose narrative and embedded Values — critical for legal/medical reports.

$hashChain.description: G20. Optional per-SemanticBlock hash chain anchor.

Log.description: G17 Branch E L6 concrete. Audit log entry. v0.0.2: adds $signature (B-LT recommended — audit records require long-term validation) and $hashChain (critical — audit chain integrity).

$signature.description: G19. Optional per-Log ML-DSA/JWS signature. Recommended profile: B-LT (audit records require long-term validation including embedded certificate and revocation data). Ensures audit log immutability even after TSA/CA decommissioning.

$hashChain.description: G20. Per-Log hash chain anchor. STRONGLY RECOMMENDED for Log entries. Enables audit trail continuity verification — a missing or reordered seqNo indicates tampered audit history.

allOf.$comment: ASSERT (RootLog): when Log appears directly under root.nodes, children limited to <=1 Value, <=1 Ref, 0 ValueBlock.
allOf.x-assert: if parent == 'root' then (count(children[Value]) <= 1 AND count(children[Ref]) <= 1 AND count(children[ValueBlock]) == 0)

Entity.description: G17 Branch A L16 concrete. The primary semantic node. v0.0.2: adds $signature (B-LT recommended) and $hashChain (RECOMMENDED — core knowledge node integrity). The $signature.payload covers the entire Entity including all children (excluding $signature/$hashChain).

$signature.description: G19. Optional per-Entity ML-DSA/JWS signature. Recommended profile: B-LT. The payload is the RFC8785-canonical JSON of the entire Entity (all properties and all children) excluding [$signature, $hashChain]. This provides strong tamper-evidence for the complete entity subtree. ML-DSA-65 recommended. For legal/medical entities use ML-DSA-87 with B-LTA.

$hashChain.description: G20. Per-Entity hash chain anchor. RECOMMENDED. Links this Entity into the document-level hash chain. blockHash = SHA256(prevHash || RFC8785(entity_without_$signature_$hashChain)). Enables detection of entity deletion or reordering without requiring signature verification.

domain.description: a2: GraphDBパーティション識別子。AuditSessionのsessionTypeと対応させる。

groundingNote.description: a2: AI推論時の補足注記。

alg.description: v0.0.2: now typed as SignatureAlgorithmType (ML-DSA or legacy JOSE).

oneOf.description: JWS compact serialization or base64-encoded binary.

Signature.description: G17 Branch F L4 concrete. Document-level signature element (v0.0.2 compatible). For per-block signatures use $signature (BlockSignature). v0.0.2: @alg typed as SignatureAlgorithmType.

HashChain.description: G18. Document-level hash chain container (v0.0.2 compatible). For per-block chains use $hashChain (BlockHashChain).

ExternalPayload.description: PERMITTED USE ONLY. (a) Sealed payloads, (b) legally mandated original-form XML, (c) binary blobs.

SignatureAlgorithmType.description: G19. Accepted signature algorithm: ML-DSA (post-quantum) or legacy JOSE. ML-DSA-65 recommended for new a2-schema documents.

MLDSAAlgorithmEnum.description: G19. NIST FIPS 204 Module-Lattice Digital Signature Algorithm identifiers. IETF draft-ietf-jose-post-quantum-algorithms. ML-DSA-44: NIST L2, pubkey 1312B, sig 2420B. ML-DSA-65: NIST L3, pubkey 1952B, sig 3293B (recommended). ML-DSA-87: NIST L5, pubkey 2592B, sig 4595B (legal/archival).

LegacySignatureAlgEnum.description: Legacy JOSE signature algorithms (RFC 7518) for backward compatibility. Prefer ML-DSA-* for new documents. EdDSA covers Ed25519/Ed448.

JAdESProfileEnum.description: JAdES conformance profile (ETSI TS 119 182-1). B-B: Basic signature. B-T: Basic + RFC3161 timestamp. B-LT: Long-term (timestamp + cert + revocation data embedded). B-LTA: Long-term with archive timestamp.

JCSCanonicalizationEnum.description: G19. Payload canonicalization method before base64url-encoding into JWS payload. RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) is the a2-schema standard. The signing payload is canonical_json(block excluding [$signature, $hashChain]).

kid.description: Key ID. URN recommended: 'urn:key:<id>'. Matches the key in the JWKS at jku.

typ.description: Media type of the JWS. Use 'a2-schema+block' for per-block signatures, 'a2-schema+root' for root-level.

cty.description: Content type of the payload. 'application/a2-schema' or 'application/json'.

b64.description: RFC 7797 unencoded payload flag. true (default) = payload is base64url-encoded. false = payload is attached unencoded (use only when payload size is critical).

crit.description: Critical header parameters that MUST be understood. Include 'sigT' when using JAdES signing time, 'b64' when present and non-default.

sigT.description: JAdES signing time (ETSI TS 119 182-1 §5.2.3). ISO 8601 UTC. MUST be in crit when present. Constitutes the B-T baseline.

iat.description: JWT/JOSE issued-at epoch seconds (RFC 7519). Redundant with sigT but included for JOSE tool compatibility.

x5c.description: X.509 certificate chain (RFC 7515 §4.1.6). Base64-encoded DER. Index 0 = signing certificate. For ML-DSA: use OQS-generated X.509 with OID 2.16.840.1.101.3.4.3.17 (ML-DSA-44), .18 (ML-DSA-65), .19 (ML-DSA-87).

x5t#S256.description: SHA-256 thumbprint of the signing certificate (RFC 7515 §4.1.8). Base64url-encoded. Enables certificate identification without full chain.

x5u.description: URI to the X.509 certificate chain (RFC 7515 §4.1.5). Alternative to x5c for size reduction.

jku.description: JWKS URI where the signing key's public key can be retrieved (RFC 7515 §4.1.2). e.g. 'https://a2-schema.org/keys/v1'.

JWSProtectedHeaderDecoded.description: G19. JWS Protected Header — decoded form for schema validation and AI readability. The 'protected' field in BlockSignature is base64url(JSON.stringify(this object)).

val.description: Base64url-encoded RFC 3161 TimeStampToken (DER). Obtained from a TSA (Time Stamp Authority) over the signature value bytes.

tsa.description: URI of the TSA that issued this timestamp token.

tstTokens.description: RFC 3161 timestamp tokens over the JWS signature value. Presence satisfies JAdES B-T requirement.

JAdESSigTst.description: JAdES etsiU entry: signature timestamp. Satisfies B-T conformance.

xVals.description: Certificate values for long-term validation. Embeds the full certificate chain needed to validate the signature even after online sources become unavailable.

JAdESXVals.description: JAdES etsiU entry: certificate values. Required for B-LT conformance.

rVals.description: Revocation data for the certificate chain. At least one of crlVals or ocspVals is required.

JAdESRVals.description: JAdES etsiU entry: revocation values (CRL + OCSP). Required for B-LT conformance.

val.description: Base64url-encoded RFC 3161 archive timestamp token over the LT-level data (signature + sigTst + xVals + rVals).

tstVD.description: Archive validation data timestamp. Satisfies B-LTA requirement.

JAdESTstVD.description: JAdES etsiU entry: archive timestamp (tstVD). Satisfies B-LTA conformance.

JAdESEtsiUEntry.description: G19. One entry in the JAdES etsiU array (unsigned properties). Entries are applied in order to achieve higher conformance levels: B-B→B-T(+sigTst)→B-LT(+xVals+rVals)→B-LTA(+tstVD).

BlockSignature.description: G19. Per-block JWS Flattened JSON Serialization (RFC 7515 §7.2.2) with JAdES extensions (ETSI TS 119 182-1). Signs the canonical JSON of the containing block (RFC 8785 JCS) using ML-DSA or legacy JOSE algorithms. Embedded directly in the signed block as '$signature'.

protected.description: REQUIRED. Base64url-encoded JWS Protected Header (RFC 7515 §4). Decoded form is described by JWSProtectedHeaderDecoded. Contains: alg, kid, typ, sigT, crit, x5c, x5t#S256, b64. Integrity of protected header is covered by the signature.

_protectedDecoded.description: NON-NORMATIVE. Human-readable decoded form of 'protected' (base64url decode → JSON parse). Provided for AI readability and debugging. NOT part of the signature computation — derived from 'protected'.

etsiU.description: JAdES unsigned properties (etsiU). Not covered by the signature — can be added after signing to upgrade conformance level. Sequence: [sigTst?, xVals?, rVals?, tstVD?].

cty.description: Unprotected content type hint. Usually redundant with protected.cty.

header.description: JWS Unprotected Header (RFC 7515 §4.1). NOT integrity-protected by the signature. Used for JAdES etsiU entries (timestamps, certificate/revocation data).

payload.description: REQUIRED. Base64url-encoded signing payload (RFC 7515 §3). Payload is: base64url(RFC8785_JCS_canonical_JSON(block EXCLUDING [$signature, $hashChain])). The payload reconstruction algorithm: (1) deep-copy block, (2) delete '$signature' and '$hashChain' keys, (3) RFC8785-JCS-canonicalize, (4) base64url-encode.

signature.description: REQUIRED. Base64url-encoded signature bytes (RFC 7515 §3). For ML-DSA-65: 3293-byte deterministic signature. Input to signing function: ASCII(base64url(protected) || '.' || base64url(payload)).

jadesProfile.description: Declared JAdES conformance profile achieved by this signature. Informative — verifier must confirm from etsiU contents.

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization method applied to the block before payload encoding. Default: RFC8785-JCS.

signingTarget.description: Informative. Identifies the block being signed, typically the $tag + @id of the signed node. e.g. 'Entity#ent-01970000-...'.

signedProperties.description: Informative. List of top-level properties included in the signing payload. Derived from the block's properties minus ['$signature', '$signatures', '$hashChain']. Used for change detection without full re-canonicalization.

signer.description: Informative. Per-signer identity the signing service set when this record was added to a multi-party A2Envelope.$signatures (email / party label 甲乙 / identityAssurance IAL-AAL-FAL / signedAt). Not part of the signed payload of OTHER records.

party.description: Role label, e.g. 甲 / 乙.

then.$comment: B-T and above: etsiU MUST contain at least one sigTst (RFC 3161 timestamp token over signature value).
B-LT and above: etsiU MUST contain xVals (certificate chain) and rVals (revocation data) for long-term validation without online lookups.
B-LTA: etsiU MUST contain tstVD (archive timestamp over LT-level data) for archival-grade long-term validation.

BlockHashChain.description: G20. Per-block lightweight HashChain anchor. Links each signed block into the document-level hash chain managed by hash-chain-api. Enables tamper detection for individual block deletion, insertion, or reordering — without requiring full document re-validation.

blockId.description: Identifies the block being chained. Typically the block's @id (NodeIdType) or '$tag#<sequential-position>' for id-less blocks.

blockHash.description: Hash of the canonical block content (RFC 8785 JCS, same scope as BlockSignature payload). Format: '<algorithm>:<hex-digest>'. e.g. 'sha256:a3b4c5d6...'.

prevHash.description: Hash of the previous block in the document-ordered chain. 'sha256:0000...0' (64 zeros) for the genesis block (first block in the document). Linking formula: blockHash = H(prevHash || canonical(block)).

docChainRef.description: Reference to the document-level chain (matches HashChain.DocumentID in Header). Allows multiple documents to share a chain namespace.

seqNo.description: 1-based sequence number of this block within the document chain. Must be monotonically increasing. Enables gap detection (missing blocks).

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm for blockHash and prevHash. SHA256 recommended; SHA384/SHA512 for archival-grade documents.

linkedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this block was appended to the hash chain. Set by hash-chain-api or SDK at document-writing time.

serviceRef.description: hash-chain-api endpoint for independent verification. POST /hash-chain/verify with blockHash + prevHash + seqNo to confirm chain integrity. e.g. 'https://hash-chain-api-xxx.run.app/hash-chain/verify'.

alg.description: ML-DSA algorithm used to sign the chain entry.

kid.description: Key ID of the signing key (hash-chain-api service key).

sig.description: Base64url-encoded ML-DSA signature over: prevHash || blockHash || seqNo || linkedAt (UTF-8, concatenated).

signedBy.description: URI/URN of the hash-chain-api signer (service identity).

chainSignature.description: ML-DSA signature over the chain entry itself (prevHash || blockHash || seqNo || linkedAt). Issued by hash-chain-api. Enables verification of each chain link without trusting the embedding document.

allOf.$comment: ASSERT: seqNo must be >= 1 (genesis block = 1). Enforced by minimum:1 above.
ASSERT: prevHash for seqNo=1 MUST be '000...0' (genesis sentinel). Runtime enforcement by SDK.

AnyNode.description: G17 + a2: Node substitution group. a2-schema built-in nodes plus AI Audit types. v4.0: adds Instruction/AIAction/AuditSession for AI Robot × AI Audit. x-a2-tier aware: extract_tier.py populates per-tier AnyNode.

kid.description: Key ID. Referenced by BlockSignature._protectedDecoded.kid and Signature.keyId.

kty.description: JOSE key type. OKP (Octet Key Pair) for lattice-based keys per IETF draft.

pub.description: Base64url-encoded ML-DSA public key. ML-DSA-44: 1312B, ML-DSA-65: 1952B, ML-DSA-87: 2592B.

x5c.description: X.509 certificate chain (base64-encoded DER). OID: 2.16.840.1.101.3.4.3.17/.18/.19 for ML-DSA-44/65/87.

mldsaKeys.description: G19. ML-DSA public key registry for this document. Lists the verification keys for all $signature entries. Enables offline signature verification without network access.

requiredOnEntity.description: If true, every Entity MUST have $hashChain.

requiredOnLog.description: If true, every Log MUST have $hashChain.

signatureRequiredOn.description: Block types that MUST carry $signature in this document.

chainPolicy.description: G19/G20. Document-level policy declaring signature and chain requirements. If signatureRequiredOn contains 'Entity', every Entity $signature becomes required rather than optional.

Header.description: G13. Document governance header. v0.0.2: adds mldsaKeys (public key registry) and chainPolicy (signature/chain requirements).

observedAt.description: G14. Document event time. MUST be <= recordedAt.

recordedAt.description: G14. System ingestion time. MUST be >= observedAt.

nodes.description: G17. Document body. All 16-layer node types. v0.0.2: nodes can carry $signature/$hashChain.

$signature.description: G19. Optional root-level ML-DSA/JWS signature. Recommended profile: B-LTA (archival). Payload = RFC8785(root excluding [$signature]). Signs the entire document including header and all nodes. Use ML-DSA-87 for legal/government documents.

allOf.$comment: G15 ASSERT: every approver with signatureRef must have matching Signature@id in document. Partial JSON Schema; full check by SDK.
allOf.x-assert: every approver-actor with signatureRef resolves to Signature@id in document

then.$comment: G15 partial: approver with signatureRef exists → nodes MUST contain >= 1 Signature with id. Full id-equality match requires SDK runtime. Fix 2026-05-12: 'header' and 'header.actors' required inside if-clause so the then-branch no longer fires vacuously when either is absent.

allOf.$comment: G19 chainPolicy enforcement: when header.chainPolicy.requiredOnEntity=true, all Entity nodes MUST have $hashChain. SDK runtime enforcement.
allOf.x-assert: if header.chainPolicy.requiredOnEntity then every Entity in nodes has $hashChain

allOf.$comment: G20 chain continuity: seqNo values across all $hashChain entries must be unique and monotonically increasing. SDK runtime enforcement.
allOf.x-assert: all $hashChain.seqNo values are unique and form a contiguous sequence 1..N

allOf.$comment: G9 ASSERT: every '#id'-form reference resolves to an existing @id in this document. Runtime SDK.
allOf.x-assert: every '#'-prefixed Ref@to, Ref@from, @source, @derivedFrom, @attributedTo resolves to a node @id

Root.description: RootType. Top-level a2-schema v0.0.2 document. v0.0.2: adds root-level $signature (B-LTA) and enforces chainPolicy. Header adds mldsaKeys registry and chainPolicy.

A2Envelope.description: doc+a2 ENVELOPE (spec: docs/apps/a2-schema-editor/doc-a2.md). Attaches a2 capability to an ordinary document. `content` is THE one unstructured dump slot: a SemanticBlock (prose/mixed; carries its own $signature/$hashChain — per-content integrity) or an ExternalPayload (sealed/binary). Detached mode: a SemanticBlock with `source` pointing at the document file and content [] — its $hashChain.blockHash covers the file bytes. `commitments` is the only structured data, validated by the INLINED self-contained `profile` (offline verification from this file alone). OpenAPI-style: this def is the one stable format schema; per-doctype profiles validate only `commitments`.

groundingPolicy.description: AI-use governance for this document (doc-a2 sets it; default 'strict').

commitments.description: The validated commitment values — the only structured data.

version.description: Document version, e.g. '1.0.0' — bumped on each save.

history.description: Save history (git-commit style): version + comment per save.

$signatures.description: One or more signatures over the canonical envelope (RFC 8785 JCS) — multi-party (甲乙…). Each element signs the same body (the signature array is excluded from the payload); single-signer = length 1. Replaces the former single $signature on the document root (v0.0.12).

signingRecipe.description: doc-a2 CONFIG (not the signature): the recipe the a2-sign app follows to fill $signature + chain. doc-a2 sets it; the sig app writes the real BlockSignature/HashChain.

A2SigningRecipe.description: doc-a2 signing/chain RECIPE (config, not crypto). doc-a2 fills this; the a2-sign app reads it and writes the real $signature (BlockSignature) + chain (HashChain), which stay strict. Anti-falsification + AI-audit only — NOT identity (no IAL/AAL/FAL).

algorithm.description: JOSE signature alg id (scheme+hash) — NOT a key size. UI labels: Ed25519='EdDSA', ML-DSA-65, RSA-4096='PS256' (RSA-PSS; the 4096 is the key size, in keyRef).

keyRef.description:
Reference to the signing key — NEVER the key material. Local 'file:///path/key.pem' | AWS 'arn:aws:kms:::key/' | GCP 'gcp-kms://projects/

/locations//keyRings//cryptoKeys//cryptoKeyVersions/'.

certificate.description: Public-key certificate a VERIFIER uses to check the integrity signature (x5u URL or identifier). Anti-falsification only — the identity assurance behind the cert (IAL/AAL/FAL) is the sig app's concern, not doc-a2's.

chainEndpoint.description: hash-chain-api endpoint, e.g. 'https://<host>/hash-chain/append'; the backend routes to the chosen store (BigQuery/Firestore).

chainNamespace.description: Partition/scope of the hash chain (which isolated tamper-evident chain this document joins — per org/region/project, so entries don't intermix).

A2HistoryEntry.description: One save in A2Envelope.history (git-commit style): the document version saved + an optional comment + when.

_____AI_AUDIT_TYPES_____.description: ─── §10 AI Audit Node Types (Instruction / AIAction / AuditSession) ──────

Instruction.$comment: a2 new. Human/system instruction to AI robot. Primary a2-sign SDK signature target. EU AI Act: human oversight record. SDK runtime validation: '#<NodeId>' cross-references not validated by JSON Schema.

type.description: 指示種別。schedule=起床/就寝時刻等,behavior=行動パターン,constraint=制約,emergency=緊急,preference=好み,order=順序

priority.description: 実行優先度。0=最低, 100=緊急停止

approvedBy.description: 承認者URI。a2-sign SDK が $signature を付与する対象。

rule.description: 指示事前条件。例: 'subject.mobility == limited → speed <= 0.3m/s'

children.description: 指示の詳細パラメータ。

$signature.description: a2-sign SDK: approvedBy が設定されている場合に必須付与。ML-DSA-65推奨。

consentBasis.$comment: ⭐ NEW GDPR Art.6 法的根拠

AIAction.$comment: a2 new. Records AI agent inference, decision, physical action. Core node of a2 audit trail. SDK runtime validation: '#<NodeId>' cross-references not validated by JSON Schema.

modelVersion.description: 推論モデルバージョン。再現性検証に必須。

actionType.description: inference=推論のみ,decision=行動選択,physical=物理動作,abort=中断,escalate=人間エスカレーション,noop=無操作

instructionRef.description: 根拠Instruction@id。'#<NodeId>'形式。因果チェーン入力リンク。SDK runtime validation.

groundingRefs.description: 推論根拠Entity/Value@idリスト。AI判断根拠の証明。'#<NodeId>'形式。SDK runtime validation.

failureReason.description: EU AI Act: 失敗原因の記録義務

humanOverride.description: EU AI Act: human oversight の証拠

sessionRef.description: 所属AuditSession@id。セッション跨ぎチェーン連結。SDK runtime validation.

children.description: 動作詳細パラメータ・センサ値・実行ログ。

$hashChain.description: a2-sign SDK: セッション内順序保証。seqNoはAuditSession内連番。

modelName.description: 推論モデル名。EU AI Act 透明性。

deploymentId.description: デプロイ識別子。再現性検証。

riskLevel.$comment: EU AI Act リスク分類 ⭐ NEW

explainability.$comment: EU AI Act Art.13 透明性 ⭐ NEW

humanOversight.$comment: EU AI Act Art.14 人的監督の詳細 ⭐ NEW (既存 humanOverride boolean を補完)。

dataLineage.$comment: 入力データ出所追跡 ⭐ NEW

AuditSession.$comment: a2 new. Container for one robot operation session. Cross-session HashChain anchor. SDK runtime validation: '#<NodeId>' cross-references not validated by JSON Schema.

sessionType.description: ロボット運用ドメイン

agentId.description: セッション実行AIエージェントURI

subjectId.description: 対象者/対象物URI。介護なら利用者ID。

prevSessionId.description: 前セッションAuditSession@id。セッション跨ぎHashChain連結。初回はnull。SDK runtime validation.

rule.description: セッション完了条件の検証式

children.description: セッション内の全Instruction/AIAction/Log。順序がHashChainのseqNoと対応。

$hashChain.description: a2-sign SDK: セッション単位HashChain。prevSessionIdの前セッション最終blockHashをこのセッション最初のprevHashとして使用。セッション跨ぎ連続性保証。

complianceFrameworks.$comment: ⭐ NEW このセッションに適用される Compliance フレームワーク。

SignedAt.$comment: §1 ISO-8601 time a node was signed.

SignatureBundle.$comment: §4. Bundle of parallel signatures (ML-DSA + RSA + handwritten).

HandwrittenSignature.$comment: ISO/IEC 19794-7:2021 準拠 手書き署名 — 筆圧・速度・軌跡・傾き全データ。a2-Sign 含む全 DocType で使用可能。

SigningCeremony.$comment: §6. 汎用署名儀式 — 全 DocType で再利用可能。

ContractClause.description: A contract clause. Extends GV SemanticBlock with taxonomy, numbering, and legal-basis tagging.

paragraphs.description: The clause body as ordered paragraphs (the 第N条 content). Each renders with a derived "1 / 2 / 3" number.

ClauseTypeEnum.description: Standard taxonomy of contract clause categories.

ConsentToESign.description: Explicit e-signature consent. Required under US ESIGN §101(c), UETA §5; expected under JP 電子署名法.

JurisdictionEnum.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, optionally with subdivision (e.g., 'US-CA', 'US-NY', 'US-DE', 'JP-13' for Tokyo).

Notarization.description: Notarial attestation. Covers traditional and remote online notarization (RON).

Paragraph.description: A numbered paragraph inside a clause (the "1 / 2 / 3" level). Its ordinal is derived at render from position in Clause.paragraphs; not stored.

paragraphText.description: The paragraph prose. May contain {{token}} references to sibling properties (see document_render_model.md P3).

ContractParty.description: A party to the contract. Extends GV Entity with contract-specific role and identity.

legalNameLocal.description: Name in local script (e.g., 株式会社○○).

legalNameKana.description: Furigana reading of the legal name (法人名フリガナ).

corporateNumber.description: Japanese corporate number (法人番号, 13 digits). Form-facing flat twin of identifiers[type=jp-corporate-number].

branchName.description: Branch / office executing the contract (支店・営業所名).

signatoryName.description: Signatory's name (署名者氏名／代表者氏名).

signatoryNameLocal.description: Signatory's name in local script (署名者氏名・現地語).

signatoryTitle.description: Signatory's title (署名者役職名). e.g., 'CEO', '代表取締役'.

signatoryEmail.description: Signatory's e-mail — e-signature routing destination (署名者メールアドレス).

signingDepartment.description: Department executing the contract (契約締結部署名／主管部課).

signingDepartmentLocal.description: Department name in local script (部署名・現地語).

sealType.description: Seal / signing method declared for this party (押印・電子署名タイプ).

x-a2-enum-descriptions.jitsuin: 実印（代表者印・登録印）
x-a2-enum-descriptions.sign-only: 署名のみ（記名押印なし）

PartyAddress.description: Postal address. Used for notices, service of process, and registered office.

jpAddressFormatted.description: Full address in Japanese format (都道府県市区町村番地建物名).

PartyIdentifier.description: Government-issued or registry identifier for a party.

PartyRoleEnum.description: Role a party plays in a contract. Domain specialization of GV ActorRoleEnum.

PartyTypeEnum.description: Legal form of party. Includes Japanese corporate forms (株式会社, 合同会社, 合資会社, 合名会社, 一般社団法人, 公益社団法人) and US forms (C-Corp, S-Corp, LLC, LP, LLP).

SignatoryBlock.description: Complete signature record for one party. Wraps GV BlockSignature with party reference, capacity, and ceremony evidence.

capacityToBind.description: e.g., 'as duly authorized officer', 'pursuant to board resolution of YYYY-MM-DD'.

SigningCeremonyEvidence.description: Evidence captured during the signing ceremony. Required for high-value contracts and disputes.

SubItem.description: A "(1) (2) (3)" sub-item inside a paragraph. Ordinal derived at render from position in Paragraph.items; not stored.

itemText.description: The sub-item prose. May contain {{token}} references to sibling properties.

uetaState.description: Whether the state has adopted UETA (49 states + DC).

_____S9_FUTURE_DOC_TYPES_____.description: ─── §9 Reserved for future modules (Medical, Robot, Life …) ───

OperationLog.$comment: §3. Universal operation-audit record (GV v0.0.11): one application operation by one actor, with identity assurance (IAL/AAL/FAL) and result. Signable + hash-chained → tamper-evident, verifiable later. Reused by every a2 app (sign/verify/view/grant/revoke/login…).

operation.$comment: what was done (app-defined free string; e.g. sign, verify, view, create, update, delete, grant, revoke, login, logout, export, configure)

onBehalfOf.$comment: delegation/agency: the principal the actor acted for

resourceId.$comment: the document / PoA / record operated on

_____S10_COMPLIANCE_____.description: ─── §10 Compliance: GDPR / EU AI Act / SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / HIPAA / PCI DSS / ESG ───

ComplianceFrameworkEnum.$comment: §10. 対応 Compliance フレームワーク。

ConsentReceipt.$comment: §10. GDPR / CCPA / 個人情報保護法 / ESIGN 同意記録。Kantara Consent Receipt v1.1 準拠。
